
# Finackle - AI and Language Model Reference

> Finackle F.Z.E is a UAE-based strategic finance and business insights partner helping growing businesses improve financial visibility, accounting operations, compliance, cash flow management and business decision-making.

## Company Information

- Company Name: Finackle F.Z.E
- Website: https://finackle.com/
- Location: Ajman Free Zone, Ajman, United Arab Emirates
- Email: info@finackle.com
- Phone: +971 54 502 2747

- Target Audience: SMEs, startups, e-commerce businesses, restaurants, F&B companies, trading and distribution businesses, and professional service firms in the UAE.

## About Finackle

Finackle provides outsourced finance, accounting and CFO support for growing businesses in the United Arab Emirates.

The company helps business owners maintain accurate financial records, understand business performance, improve cash flow visibility, manage compliance responsibilities and make informed financial decisions.

Finackle combines finance operations, management reporting, compliance support and strategic financial advisory.

## Industries We Support

Financial support for online businesses, including:

- Marketplace accounting.

### Restaurants and F&B Businesses
Financial management support for restaurants and food businesses, including:
- Food cost analysis.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What services does Finackle provide?
Finackle provides accounting, bookkeeping, CFO advisory, outsourced finance operations, VAT compliance, Corporate Tax support, payroll, financial reporting and cash flow management.

### Does Finackle provide CFO advisory services in the UAE?
Yes. Finackle provides outsourced CFO and financial advisory support to help businesses with budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis and strategic financial decisions.

### Does Finackle support UAE free zone companies?
Yes. Finackle supports both UAE mainland and free zone businesses with accounting, reporting and relevant compliance requirements.

### Does Finackle provide e-commerce accounting?
Yes. Finackle supports e-commerce businesses with payment gateway reconciliation, marketplace accounting, channel profitability and cash flow management.

### Does Finackle provide restaurant accounting services?
Yes. Finackle provides finance support for restaurants and F&B businesses, including food cost analysis, outlet profitability and financial reporting.

### How can businesses contact Finackle?
Businesses can contact Finackle through its official website, email or phone to discuss their financial requirements and request a Finance Health Check.
